en.heading: Installing Foundation
intro: Foundation is a component, but parts of it have to live in your database: a small set of methods it calls, the tables some of its modules keep their data in, and the forms its windows are built on. Nothing has been added yet.

The items listed below are missing from this database. Choose Install to add them all now, or Cancel to add nothing. If you cancel, your database is left untouched and you can simply remove the component.
Foundation is free software under the MIT licence. There is nothing to accept and nothing to register.
en.startupWhy: Foundation starts and quits only when your database methods call it. Add each line to its method, creating the method if you have none:
en.startupCreate: If "Start Foundation when this database opens" is ticked, Install creates whichever of these methods your database lacks. A method you already have is never changed: add the line to it yourself.
en.startFoundation: Start Foundation when this database opens
en.startupReminder: Foundation starts and quits only when your database methods call it: add Fnd_Shell_OnStartup to On Startup and Fnd_Shell_OnExit to On Exit, creating either method if you have none.
en.tablesWhy: Storage for preferences, choice lists and sequence numbers.
en.hooksWhy: Empty methods where you add your own code. Foundation calls them at set points, such as startup or before a record is deleted.
en.hostWhy: Small methods that let the component reach things only your database can, such as its forms, lists and pictures.
en.upgradeWhy: These tables were made by an earlier Foundation and lack something it now expects: a primary key, or a place in your database's journal. Each is listed with what it needs. Where a primary key is added, any row whose ID is empty, or the same as another row's, is given a new ID.
en.upgradeReason_key: needs a primary key; it will also be journaled
en.upgradeReason_journal: has its primary key; it is excluded from the journal and will be included
en.formsWhy: The forms Foundation's windows are built on. They are copied into your database's Forms folder, with the pictures they use into a folder named Foundation in its Resources folder. A form or picture already there is never replaced.
en.hookUpdatesWhy: These hook methods are in your database already, and the version Foundation supplies has changed since. Nothing is written unless you tick a box and choose Apply. Your present code for each ticked method is first saved in a folder named Foundation Backups, in your database's folder.
en.hookReplace: Replace with Foundation's current version. Yours is as Foundation supplied it in {{release}}.
en.hookMerge: Apply Foundation's changes to your version. Yours began as Foundation's {{release}}, and the changes do not overlap yours.
en.hookConflict: Foundation's changes overlap yours, so they cannot be applied automatically. Yours began as Foundation's {{release}}. Copy what you want by hand.
en.hookCompare: Yours differs from Foundation's current version, and the version it began from is not known. Compare them and copy what you want by hand.
en.hookCompareGroup: {{count}} hook methods differ from Foundation's current version in ways it cannot trace to one of its own versions, usually because they were written for an earlier Foundation. For reference only.
en.hookChangesMerged: Your code with Foundation's changes applied
en.hookChangesConflict: Your code and Foundation's changes, with the conflicts marked
en.hookChangesCompare: Yours compared with Foundation's current version
en.hooksBackups: The code they replaced was saved in:
en.changedWhy: These forms and pictures are in your database already and differ from the ones this Foundation carries. Nothing here is changed by Install. Superseded: Foundation has a newer version and yours is as Foundation supplied it. Edited: yours has been changed since it was installed.
en.changedAlert: These forms and pictures differ from the ones this Foundation carries. Nothing was changed:
en.compilerWhy: Typing declarations for the methods above.
en.footerHooks: Your own code in a hook method is never changed unless you tick it in the section for hook methods Foundation has changed.
en.footer: A form or picture already in your database is never changed. A Foundation host method whose parameters are out of date is replaced, with the previous code kept below it as a comment.
en.changesHeading: What has changed in this release
en.noticeText:
A new release of Foundation, {{version}}, is installed in this database.

Review now shows what has changed and whether anything is missing from your database. Nothing is changed unless you choose Install there.
en.installed:
Foundation has been installed.
Restart the database before using it, so that:

1. The new tables are available, and
2. The newly created methods will compile.
en.installedNoTables:
Foundation has been installed.
Restart the database before using it, so that the newly created methods will compile.
en.installedForms: The forms have been copied into your database.
en.notCompleted: These could not be completed and were left as they were:
en.alreadyInstalled: Foundation is already installed in this database. There is nothing to add.
en.compiledHost: Fnd_Shell_Installer needs an interpreted database. Nothing was changed.
en.notAHost: Open your own database with Foundation in its Components folder, then run Fnd_Shell_Installer there.
